content.title: Search for a product by name
content.description: A shopper enters a product name from any page, can access the search control in the header on home and category pages, receives structured results for matching terms, receives an explicit no-match message for unsuccessful terms, and can revisit or share the results by URL.
content.value: Helps shoppers quickly reach intended products without browsing through categories.
criteria: The search box is present in the header on the home page and on category pages.
A matching search returns at least one product tile, and each tile shows a product name and a price.
A no-match search shows an explicit "no product matches" style message rather than an empty page or an error.
Search results are reachable via a shareable URL that includes the search term.
